memory_update.text: Clean US-listed pure plays in HPQ mining and quartz crucibles appear scarce; core assets such as Sibelco, The Quartz Corp., Momentive Technologies, and CoorsTek are private or non-US-listed, so public mapping must use adjacent equipment, services, wafer-substrate, and OTC speculative alternatives.
UCTT should be tracked as an underfollowed ultra-high-purity semiconductor component and chamber-parts services candidate with explicit quartz cleaning/service adjacency, not as a direct HPQ miner.
ASYS is a below-$300M speculative exception with wafer/substrate processing equipment and consumables exposure; verify customer overlap with wafer makers or substrate suppliers before advancing.

HMRFF and PYRGF are OTC speculative-shadow names tied to alternative silica/quartz or processing technologies; do not advance without independent purity, scale-up, customer qualification, and commercial economics evidence.

The investable chokepoint may sit less in HPQ mining itself and more in qualified quartzware fabrication, chamber-part cleaning, wafer/substrate tools, and qualification bottlenecks around ultra-high-purity materials.

summary: This pass found few clean US-listed pure plays in high-purity quartz or quartz crucibles because the critical Spruce Pine HPQ miners and major crucible makers are mostly private or foreign-listed. The more investable US/OTC universe is therefore a shadow lane: ultra-high-purity semiconductor component services, wafer/substrate equipment and consumables, and speculative alternative-source or process developers. Candidates below are research leads only, not recommendations; most require filing-level confirmation that quartz, HPQ, crucibles, wafer-substrate consumables, or semiconductor-grade silica are financially material.
